name: Cainsville Files
source:
Cainsville Files features Jenn McCoy, a struggling private investigator who finds herself searching for her missing high-school sweetheart–possibly a victim of the notorious Valentine Killer. With your help, Jenn's investigation will lead her into strange, otherworldly territory, including the mysterious town of Cainsville, where secrets lurk in every shadow. Your choices will either help Jenn solve the case–or doom her to a number of memorably gruesome fates.

[From [url=http://www.penguin.com/static/pages/features/amplified_editions/cainsville_files_app.php]official website[/url]]
translation:
《Cainsville Files》的主角珍·麦考伊是一名生活拮据的私家侦探。她正在寻找失踪的高中恋人，而对方可能已经成为臭名昭著的“情人节杀手”的受害者。在你的帮助下，珍的调查将逐步深入诡异、超乎常理的领域，包括神秘的凯恩斯维尔镇——那里每一处阴影中都潜藏着秘密。你的选择可以帮助珍侦破案件，也可能让她迎来种种惨烈而难忘的死亡结局。

（来源：[url=http://www.penguin.com/static/pages/features/amplified_editions/cainsville_files_app.php]官方网站[/url]）
